name: Columbia Gulf Maysville Project

values.StartLocation: Columbia Gulf mainline tie-in, Rowan County
values.EndLocation: North Maysville delivery meter station, Hugh L. Spurlock Power Station, Mason County

researcher_notes: Passes all threshold legs. Sponsor is Columbia Gulf Transmission, owned by TC Energy. It applied to FERC in November 2025 under docket CP26-25 and the Federal Register notice of January 20, 2026 sets the environmental assessment schedule. The notice states 42 miles of new 30-inch pipe in Rowan, Fleming and Mason Counties, Kentucky, to a new meter station at the Spurlock Power Station. A Pipeline and Gas Journal article from January 2026 states 340,000 Dth/d. The EIA pipeline projects release of August 2026 (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 77) lists it as Maysville Expansion Project, Applied, in service 2029, 42 miles, 340 MMcf/d, 30 inches, cost 400 million dollars (not staged). EIA is one origin and the FERC notice is independent of it. Existing row P6533 is the Columbia Gulf system row with no lengths, so this is not a match; no Maysville lateral exists in the roster. Staged as an expansion-style row under the parent system name as the roster spells it. The FERC notice describes a lateral, so pipeline type is lateral. Proposal year 2025 comes from the application date of November 17, 2025 (EIA note). Owner name not in the gazetteer; written as the FERC notice spells it without the comma. Parent TC Energy Corp is an exact gazetteer hit. No route geometry found; official FERC GIS not retrieved, so route is left as no route and should be sought from the FERC filing.
